extDescription.message: Right-click images or text to open them in 200+ free tools, search every tool, and capture the screen — all in your browser.

notifyNoAccess.message: Allow GoodWebTools Companion to read images on websites to send them to a tool.

notifyTooBig.message: That file is too large to hand over (over 50 MB). Download it and open it in the tool instead.

commandCapture.message: Capture the screen (works while another window is focused)

color_hint.message: Press Pick, then click anywhere on the screen.

color_unsupported.message: This browser has no color picker (EyeDropper).

shotTabChanged.message: The screenshot stopped because you switched tabs. Try again and stay on the page until it finishes.

notifyPageFailedTitle.message: That didn't work on this page

notifyWaitTabTitle.message: Switch to the tab you picked

notifyWaitTabShot.message: Chrome only captures a tab while it’s showing. Click that tab and the screenshot finishes by itself.

notifyWaitTabRec.message: Chrome only records a tab while it’s showing. Click that tab — the recording shows it from then on.

notifyWaitWindowShot.message: It looks minimised or hidden. Bring it up and the screenshot finishes by itself.

notifyWaitWindowRec.message: It looks minimised or hidden. Bring it up — the recording shows it from then on.

notifyCaptureNoFrame.message: The picked tab or window never came into view, so nothing was captured. Try again and switch to it.

menuSelCompare.message: Compare… (pick this, then the other text)

menuSelRegex.message: Test a regex on this text

menuPageLinks.message: List all links on this page

notifyCompareFirst.message: Now select the other text, right-click and choose “Compare with the first selection”.

notifyNoText.message: No readable text found on this page.

notifyNoField.message: Click into a text field first, then right-click it.
